bibliographic infrastructure; requested task queue is based on the primary article references

supplement_guide: Read in full. It identifies the title, authors, affiliations, and supplement table of contents; it adds no unique empirical results.
visual_strategy: All 19 primary pages were rendered and visually inspected. The entire 201-page supplement was text-mapped; design/eligibility/treatment pages 63-85 and statistical-analysis pages 140-155 were separately rendered and visually checked. Other supplement pages were included only when text mapping showed material methodological content.
coverage_decision: Whole primary article covered. Supplement covered hierarchically for methodologically relevant sections. Bibliographies and administrative material were excluded from atomization.
omissions: No main-article figure or table omitted.
